name: Declared integrations are reachable and used
purpose: Every enduring integration a system declares is reachable by the AI, and one that is declared but never used is reported.
record: The share of a system's declared enduring integrations that the AI can reach and has used in its recent runs. Draft: no cases or runs exist yet, and the metric needs a system that declares integrations.
disadvantages: A draft: it names what to measure; the declared integrations and the run records it reads are the system's own.
